verdict.rationale: Lorikeet says its agent takes action through your APIs and MCP servers inside natural-language and deterministic workflows. Examples include tools like 'get-order-status', a refund workflow, and payments or disputes handling. On scoping, it claims workflow-scoped tool access and server-side identity validation enforced in code, which is close to per-action scoped auth but stated at the workflow level and only in marketing copy. Missing for 10: documented per-action credential/auth scoping configuration, explicit evidence of refund/order-change/subscription-update API actions being executed, developer docs on how API tools are defined and authenticated, independent or hands-on corroboration.
